parts:
Hi,

I am Daksh currently in 4th year, pursuing my Integrated Masters in Technology degree(5 year B.Tech+ M.Tech) at International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore. During my undergraduate studies, I have developed a keen interested in the field of Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing, text mining in particular. I have worked on two full semester long projects in the same field which used R extensively. I would like to contribute to the project - Integration of Text Mining and Topic Modeling Tools under GSoC 2016.

I have solved one of the three tests that were posted on the wiki page of the project. For the second test, I had a query regarding the TreeTagger module. Can we assume that the module is already installed on the host system or our script should take care of that?

Since the project idea matches with my area of interest, I am pretty keen on contributing to the project.

Thanking you,
Daksh Varshneya
